result.limitation: Validate assumptions and current AWS documentation. This is not an official AWS review, security audit, deployment or price quote.
preconditions: Use a disposable environment or synthetic target
Define authorized operator, cost limit, stop condition and recovery owner
Capture input digest, target version and execution ID
steps: Record expected state and independent success evidence
Inject after-write-crash at a documented boundary
Observe target state independently of orchestration state
Reconcile before any retry; block unknown outcomes
Record outcome and restore the test environment
acceptance: Uncertain outcomes are visible and block blind replay
Evidence identifies the tested version and limitations
